component.name: Claude
component.summary: AI assistant for chat, coding, and analysis

description.p: Claude Desktop is a native desktop client for Claude, the AI assistant made by Anthropic. Chat with Claude, write and review code with Claude Code, work through documents, and hand longer tasks to Cowork.
Claude Code runs in an integrated terminal with an editor and a diff view, so you can read every change before you keep it. Model Context Protocol servers let Claude reach the tools you already use.
A claude.ai account is required. Some features need a paid plan.

This package is community maintained. Anthropic builds the application and does not support this packaging. The application itself is not redistributed here: it is downloaded from Anthropic when you install this package.
